description.value: Open Space is a 1500-square-foot flexible cultural venue in the heart of historic Downtown Abbotsford, operated by the Abbotsford Downtown Business Association. It hosts curated art exhibitions, artisan markets, workshops, and micro-events, serving as a creative hub connecting local artists and small businesses. A touring cyclist passing through downtown Abbotsford could drop in to browse a gallery show or catch a pop-up market.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 19m; rack (3 spaces) at 54m; rack (4 spaces) at 80m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Open Space is an active cultural gallery and event venue at 33765 Essendene Ave in downtown Abbotsford, operated by the Abbotsford Downtown Business Association. The venue features section lists 1500 sq ft flexible floor space, kitchenette access, and staging equipment, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water access for cyclists. The OSM community tag lists 'Chilliwack' but the address and website clearly place this in Abbotsford, indicating a data error.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'Chilliwack' but the address and website clearly place this venue in Abbotsford — likely a mapping data error.
OSM has no phone number; (778) 666-0451 is the ADBA general line shown on the website footer, not a dedicated Open Space line.
None of the required criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the venue's website; all remain unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Open Space is a legitimate cultural attraction in a walkable downtown, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed by the website. On-site follow-up is needed to determine whether the venue can meet minimum cycling-friendliness thresholds.
enrichment_extras.notes: The ADBA main office address (33660 South Fraser Way) differs from the Open Space venue address (33765 Essendene Ave); both appear intentional and correct for their respective entities.

wow_evidence: Small flexible cultural venue with exhibitions and markets — walk-in when programming is on.
blurb: Downtown micro-venue for exhibitions and artisan markets.
